parties: BOW 40 - Tata Patagonia - Ramiro Clemente Diaz
procedural_matters: Martin Mahon, helmsman of IRL 4265, gave evidence as a witness for IRL 5270.
Alberto Benedetti, trimmer of ITA 438, gave evidence as a witness for ARG 5453.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 20-22 knots and one metre waves.
ARG 5453 tacked from port to starboard tack clear ahead and slightly to leeward of IRL 5270, who was sailing a close-hauled course on starboard tack.
After ARG 5453 reached a close-hauled course, IRL 5270 luffed above a close-hauled course and established an overlap 1 metre to windward of ARG 5453.
conclusions: After reaching a close-hauled course and acquiring right-of-way as clear ahead boat, ARG 5453 initially gave IRL 5270 room to keep clear as required by RRS 15.
